items.title: Karl Berger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014
items.q: John Lee Hooker, you’d hear that all the time.

ctx.x: John Lee Hooker, you’d hear that all the time. And I remember way early on in that club in Heidelberg there was a concert series coming through called — it was sort of a blues, it was like a tour that Norman Granz did I think.
